detailed_descriptions.en: After a failed heist, a group known as the Renegades is forced to flee, crash landing near the mysterious planet Paimo. With no other choice, they descend into its depths in search of help and uncover secrets that should have remained buried. DESCEND WITH FRIENDS Descend solo or with up to two friends into the dangerous depths of PAIMO. Coordinate your abilities, share gadgets, and work together to survive. But watch your back... sometimes you’ll need to unleash your inner Renegade and break away from the group to maximize your rewards. GADGETS, WEAPONS AND ULTIMATES Inside the MineGeon, every run is a chance to grow stronger. Level up to unlock powerful Gadgets that grant a wide variety of upgrades to aid you in battle, equip a variety of weapons to match your playstyle, and choose Ultimates that can completely change how you approach combat. Combining Gadgets, Weapons, and Ultimates creates unique synergies that will shape your descent into PAIMO. BRING OUT YOUR INNER GREED PAIMO is filled with minerals that bring out your inner greed. The deeper you descend, the greater the rewards and the risks. Collect valuable minerals and trade them for permanent upgrades, but choose wisely when to send them back to your ship. FACE ENEMIES DESPERATE TO STOP YOU The biomes of PAIMO are home to a vast array of enemies. Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter the Scavengers, who will do anything to stop your descent. Why are they so determined to keep you from going deeper? Each biome culminates in a boss battle that will push your skills and strategies to the limit. GROW STRONGER EVERY RUN Progression is key to your survival and success. As you explore and gather resources, you can upgrade your skills and equipment to grow stronger with every run. Invest in permanent upgrades for your spaceship and enhance each Renegade’s attributes to prepare for the challenges ahead. CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP Access the Galactic Express PC to buy over 200 items, decorations, and themed objects from the biomes you explore, and customize the interior of your ship to your liking. Organize your base, visit other Renegades' ships online, and show off your setup to the community. CHOOSE YOUR RENEGADE Choose from three classes, each with their own ultimate ability and unique stats. From Marshall, the resilient Tank, to Trevor, the deadly DPS Gunslinger, and Ari, the balanced Engineer. Find your role within the team and combine your strengths with other Renegades to maximize your chances of surviving the descent into PAIMO. CHOOSE YOUR DESCENT Deep within PAIMO lie mysterious monoliths pulsing with ancient technology. These relics let the Renegades decide how to continue their descent, vote as a team to choose the path that benefits everyone, or follow your own ambition. Add MineGeon: Renegades to your wishlist and join the adventure!
